messages.speak_truncated: The text continues. Open the clipboard history to read all of it.
messages.empty_history: Nothing copied yet. Text you copy while Hariku is running appears here.
messages.copy_failed: Could not put the text on the clipboard. Please try again.
messages.item_gone: That item is no longer in the history.
messages.nothing_to_clear: There is nothing to clear. Pinned items are kept.
messages.confirm_clear: Clear the clipboard history? Every item that is not pinned is deleted ({count} in all). Pinned items are kept.
messages.privacy_note: Text copied from password managers such as KeePass, 1Password and Bitwarden is never recorded. Unless Remember history is on, the history is kept in memory only and is gone when Hariku closes. Pinned items are the exception: they are always saved on this computer, so they are still there after a restart. Turning Remember history off deletes the saved history at once, except pinned items. Nothing is ever sent over the internet.
